messages.author: 457dba916c5b95c4
messages.subject: SensorTag
parts:
It would be great if this package could explicitly support the SensorTag from TI.

I noticed in the notes attached to the package that the author was offering to extend if was requested.
I am kindly requesting :-)

;mE

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] SensorTag
parts:
Dear Mario,

In the package documentation I wrote: "If you want to use this package
for a different data format (e.g. from a different accelerometer
brand) then please provide me with: the R-code to read the data and
example files for testing purposes."

So, if you can provide me with the R-code to read their data and a few
example files then I could do an effort to implement it in the
package.

Vincent

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] SensorTag

My apologies to state it incorrectly.
The device streams based on what the developer code. However, I can propose a basic stream to extract everything available and share
the code NodeJS or whatever so whoever else whats to use that hardware can rely on that protocol and the support from R.
If that is agreeable, I will jump on it and I will post once it’s done. Just let me know and thanks fo the quick turn around. Much appreciated.

;mE
